methodological_rigor.justification: Retrospective real-world study of trastuzumab deruxtecan in Chinese HER2-positive/HER2-low breast cancer cohort. Appropriate outcome measures (efficacy, safety). No comparison group or control. Standard statistical analysis (likely chi-square, Kaplan-Meier). No power analysis. Methodologically sound for real-world evidence but limited rigor.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: Real-world evidence of approved therapeutic agent in specific population. Directly relevant to clinical practice for HER2-positive and HER2-low breast cancer management. Addresses pragmatic questions of efficacy and safety in routine practice.

reporting_quality.justification: Methods adequately described for real-world study. STROBE elements partially addressed. Outcome definitions clear. However, no data sharing statement and patient-level data not accessible.

novelty_literature.justification: Real-world confirmation of trastuzumab deruxtecan efficacy in specific population. No novel biological mechanisms, biomarkers, or treatment strategies. Confirmatory evidence in Chinese cohort has some value but limited novelty.

writing_presentation.justification: Clearly presented real-world outcomes with appropriate safety and efficacy reporting. Tables and figures effectively communicate findings. Discussion contextualizes within clinical trial data.

key_strengths: Real-world pragmatic evidence supporting trastuzumab deruxtecan efficacy in Chinese breast cancer population
Clear safety and efficacy outcomes with practical clinical relevance
Addresses clinically relevant question of agent performance outside clinical trial settings
key_concerns: No mechanistic insights or biomarker discovery
Chinese population specificity may limit global generalizability
chief_reviewer.rationale: Solid real-world evidence study with clinical relevance but limited novelty. Appropriate for Tier 4 with minor revisions. Could include cost-effectiveness analysis to increase impact.
